dct_creator_sm: Gustas, Robert (University of Victoria). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2856-2596
dct_description_sm: This data set contains the supplemental information documents for Estimating Ancient Nuu-chah-nulth Fisheries Biomass at Shell Midden Sites on the Northwest Coast. Included documents describe weighted fish body mass calculations, estimated fish biomass calculations, site specific biomass and fish count estimates, historical and pre-contact fish catch comparisons, detailed formulae breakdowns, and sensitivity analysis.
dct_title_s: Supplementary Information for Estimating Ancient Nuu-chah-nulth Fisheries Biomass at Shell Midden Sites on the Northwest Coast
